title: Paprika chicken, green bean and chickpea salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Chicken, vegetables, tinned chickpeas, mustard, vinegar and oil are all ordinary kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, saucepan and bowl, with simple frying and boiling.

works.reason: 500g chicken, 300g beans, two peppers, a tin of chickpeas and rocket make a sensible lunch for four, and the 3 tbsp oil to 1 tbsp vinegar dressing is well balanced.

honest_times.reason: Slicing the chicken, peppers and onion and trimming the beans fits 15 minutes, and the frying and boiling overlap to about 15 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm salad of green beans and peppers suits a July lunch, and the beans are a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a balanced meal of protein, pulses and plenty of vegetables that a family would happily eat.
